storage_policy: Original payloads are collected only on GitHub-hosted runners; local storage holds metadata and documents.

sources.title: Plan4Res / EDF case study 3 public data V2.1 with official D4.5 documentation V4.2
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 for both version-specific official Zenodo records
sources.license_evidence: Both record APIs explicitly report open access and cc-by-4.0. Documentation record is directly linked by the dataset record. Retrieved 2026-10-18.
sources.citation: Sandrine Charousset, Slimane Noceir, Dominique Daniel and Nadia Oudjane (EDF), 2020. plan4res public dataset for case study 3: Cost of RES integration and impact of climate change for the European Electricity System in a future world with high shares of renewable energy sources, version 2.1, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3802550. Mauro Dell'Amico et al. (2020), Documentation of the plan4res public dataset - deliverable D4.5, version 4.2, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3785010. Full creator lists retained in official metadata snapshots.
sources.model_scope: Official public research data for Plan4Res case study 3, classified by publisher as unit commitment, seasonal storage valuation, flexibility and uncertainty for the European electricity system. Archive name explicitly identifies ReferenceWithoutClimateChange. Bundled official D4.5 documentation describes data formats, transformations and construction. Data and documentation count as one source group.
upstream_caveats: The selected version is the reference-without-climate-change archive; do not claim that all climate-change scenarios or all three Plan4Res studies are included.
Public portion is archived as published; completeness for a particular UC formulation and parameter activation are not independently verified.
The D4.5 PDF documents several project case studies and is not an additional UC system.
No demand-response module or hard carbon cap is certified for this archived case.
The current GitHub toyDataset is a different versioned artifact; its license must not be inferred from these Zenodo licenses.
No inner ZIP contents or PDF pages are interpreted, no parameter table parsed, no transformation or solver run.
